digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation and mutation verb tracking
propositions: Structural test assertions on the shared confirmation reduce path (_confirm.emit/_confirm.emit_text seam) must catch regressions where confirmation bypasses the shared seam and prints per-verb, not just per-verb exact-line tests.

Verb no-op inventory (no-op-capable vs always-writes classification for all 17 MUTATION_VERBS) must be curated, rendered into generated docs, and enforced by drift-gate so a new verb added without classification causes CI failure.
Per-verb old→new confirmation-line mapping (pre-42cd70b889 output vs current) must be recorded as golden data in generated docs or test suite for reference and regression visibility.
Seam-spy test must parametrize across create, link, and transition verbs with variants for no-op paths (re-link, already-at-status transition) to verify exactly one routed line per dispatch.
Confirmation formatters must require no store read access (formatter call succeeds with cwd in empty tmpdir and REBAR_ROOT unset) to ensure no follow-up store dependency after the shared seam.
CI gates (make lint, make typecheck) and 572-file type-check suite must pass; generator drift gate must fail if verb key set diverges from rebar._cli._CONFIRM_SCOPE.
